role: The @Observable MainActor RRCollector orchestration shell: injected dependencies (including the shared SessionScoringContext), back-compat forwarders to DeviceStatus/SessionState/CollectorSessionControl/SessionScoringContext, archive read helpers, strap-recovery predicates, wiring factory and deferred baseline rebuild; plus RRCollectorError and two file-scope phase label helpers. Saved-session reanalysis is the composition root's SessionReanalysisCoordinator, not the collector's.
types: RRCollector.LiveHRVSnapshotMirror: struct — Sendable snapshot for LiveHRVBroker
RRCollectorError: enum — collector errors with localized descriptions
state: RRCollector.scoring: SessionScoringContext (settings, baseline, training load), injected or built from the settings manager, HealthKit and baseline tracker
toplevel: Stored-property initializers: deviceFetchPolicy .automatic, useDeviceBackupForOvernight true, overnightDeviceBackupActive false, isOvernightEnding false, armingRetryInterval = StrapRecordingPolicy.armingRetryIntervalSeconds, streamingTimerBox lock(nil), liveHRVSnapshotMirror lock(nil), didBootBaseline lock(false), verification = Verification(), streamingVerification relaxed config (minPoints from CollectorSessionControl.minimumQuickReadingBeats). typealias CollectorError = RRCollectorError. The header doc maps each extension file to the coordinator that owns its behaviour and says saved-session reanalysis belongs to the composition root.

True when the strap reports a stored exercise with a known start that the app has not saved (isStrapRecordingSaved: downloaded or predating the ledger, and held on this device by an archived session or a rescue backup near its start). A recording downloaded but stored nowhere — a failed rescue backup, or the app killed before the night was saved — counts as unrecovered, so the Recover card offers it.

branches.cond: stored exercise exists and its date is known
